raw.title: Head of Business Operations / Senior Business Operations Manager - all genders welcome!
raw.description:
About the Job

Join us in reshaping the future of golf! With a team of over 85 passionate people, we're dedicated to our mission in revolutionizing the golf industry one swing at a time. Our international team, based in Munich, is seeking a motivated Head of Business Operations or Senior Business Operations Manager to become part of our company in a dynamic and innovative environment. In this role, you help translate our revenue targets into an operational plan and bring five independent teams together along this plan. You are the central interface for planning, timing, and alignment in the revenue and marketing area, holding everything together. Ready to embrace your Vice?


Skip the copy paste. Show us your swing

Your CV tells us what you’ve done. We want to understand why those experiences make you the right person for this role. So make your application your own: tailor your CV, tell us about your most relevant achievement, or surprise us with a short presentation. This isn’t a design contest, we’re interested in how you think, what you bring to the table, and what you want to achieve at Vice.


Your Fairway

  • Break down monthly and quarterly D2C targets into weekly and daily targets with specific references to products and promotional campaigns
  • Develop target proposals for C-level executives, who will approve the final plan
  • Maintain the product and promotional calendar, taking processes and deadlines into account
  • Ensuring lead times across five teams (E-commerce & UX, CRM, Performance Marketing, Brand & Marketing, Tech) and identifying and resolving deviations early on
  • Leading the weekly trading review
  • Analyzing problems and developing solutions together with the teams
  • Supporting the expansion of planning to additional sales channels (Green Grass, Specialty Retail, Amazon, etc.)
  • Making independent decisions regarding promotional calendars, discounts, and team prioritization; final decisions regarding budget, pricing, and P&L remain the responsibility of our C-level


Your Scorecard

  • Commercial numerical understanding and judgment rather than pure reporting of numbers

  • Fluency in spoken and written German and English

  • Several years of professional experience (3+ years) in business operations, consulting, chief of staff, commercial, and program management, or comparable experience in complex organizational areas is preferred

  • A background in performance marketing, content, or e-commerce technology is an asset but not a requirement

  • Organizational talent to bring five teams together, identify dependencies early on, and ensure alignment before a gap turns into a problem

  • Critical mindset to challenge the status quo, contribute your own ideas, and actively help shape the future rather than just following plans

  • Structured thinking with foresight

  • Strong communication skills to convince experienced team leads on an equal footing and think creatively with them about the future, while still giving them the space to apply their technical expertise

  • A passion for golf is a plus, but not a requirement 


Note: We use Artificial Intelligence to support this process; the final decision still remains with a human.


Our Clubhouse

  • We embrace diversity and innovation. Our motley team comes from all backgrounds and perspectives, united by fresh and bold ideas.

  • Taking ownership from day one. Our ambitious vision relies on every individual stepping up to bring Vice Golf to the next level.

  • Make your work hours fit your life. Flexible work arrangements and remote work options cater to your work-life balance.

  • Grow with us. We place great emphasis on your personal development, where you benefit from not only regular performance feedback but also an annual training budget.

  • Escape the routine. Within the EU, you’re free to choose your workspace for two weeks a year.

  • Stay active. We’re invested in your well-being, subsidizing EGYM Wellpass so you can train for only 30 € a month.

  • Enjoy! Fuel your day with a varied selection of fresh meals and snacks from our Foodji.

  • Secure your (far) future! While retirement might seem distant to you, we’ve got you covered with options to enroll in our corporate pension plan.

  • Work hard play hard. Work on your golf skills and refine your swing on the state-of-the-art golf simulator and putting green in our office.

  • Enjoy the open bar. Have some Afterwork drinks on our rooftop while enjoying the view of the Alps.

title: Product Owner (all genders) - Management Suite Tribe
description: Welcome to baramundi! “Where security, automation and centralized control come together, modern endpoint management begins.” Do you want to actively shape modern UEM solutions, translate technical complexity into clear product decisions and create real value for IT administrators together with strong development teams? Then become part of our Management Suite Tribe and help drive the further development of our primarily on-premise Unified Endpoint Management solution as a Product Owner. At baramundi, we develop software solutions that enable companies to centrally manage, secure and automate their endpoints. As a Product Owner, you work closely with development, Product Management, Support, Consulting and our customers in an agile, interdisciplinary environment. Your goal: to translate product requirements into valuable, prioritized and actionable features. Do what you do best: DRIVE PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT IN THE MANAGEMENT SUITE TRIBE You take content responsibility for two development squads and, together with them, further develop key product areas of the baramundi Management Suite, primarily in Windows Endpoint Management – from fundamental client-server communication to compliance and defense management, Windows OS installation, co-management and Windows Update Management. You are part of the Product Owner Chapter and work closely within the leadership trio of Chapter Lead, Scrum Master and Product Owner. TRANSLATE REQUIREMENTS INTO CLEAR PRODUCT INCREMENTS You understand technical and functional complexity, formulate features and product backlog items precisely and ensure clear, testable acceptance criteria. You prioritize the product backlog based on customer value, effort, dependencies and stakeholder input. DELIVER WITH YOUR TEAMS You are the primary contact person for content-related and product-related questions from your development teams, make progress transparent and ensure that your squads can work in a focused, informed and empowered way. At the same time, you balance maintenance, quality and new features. BE THE BRIDGE BETWEEN PRODUCT, DEVELOPMENT AND STAKEHOLDERS You work closely with Product Management, Support, Consulting, customers as well as internal and external development partners, actively gather feedback and translate requirements into concrete development steps. In doing so, you represent product value just as clearly as the perspective of your teams. COORDINATE EXTERNAL PROJECTS AND DEVELOPMENT SERVICES You coordinate external teams and projects from a content perspective, ensure clear requirements, transparent alignment and reliable integration into product development. USE AI MEANINGFULLY IN YOUR PRODUCT OWNER ROUTINE You use AI tools in a reflective and pragmatic way – for example when creating features and PBIs, structuring requirements or developing quick prototypes for stakeholder feedback. What we appreciate about you: Several years of experience as a Product Owner or in a comparable role with product responsibility in an agile software development environment. Experience in providing content leadership for multiple development teams as well as integrating and coordinating external projects or developers. Confidence working with Scrum, Kanban and backlog tools – ideally Azure DevOps – as well as experience in scaled agile ways of working. Solid knowledge of or strong interest in Unified Endpoint Management, Client Lifecycle Management and Windows-based IT infrastructures. Ability to quickly understand technical complexity and translate it into clear, prioritizable requirements. Analytical, data-based decision-making and a high standard of quality. Strong communication skills in German and English and enjoyment in working with different stakeholders. Ability to provide content leadership at eye level, create orientation and foster open, transparent exchange within the team. Bonus: background in IT administration, practical knowledge of software development, experience with the Azure technology stack or touchpoints with Linux, macOS, Android or iOS. Meet us! 10 reasons to choose baramundi! #1 ARRIVE IN PEACE Our all-inclusive package makes starting particularly easy. Your personal onboarding buddy will show you everything: from the welcome breakfast to the fully equipped workplace. #2 FEEL AT HOME Coffee, fruit, and drinks are free. We take care of your mail and packages. Once a month, all baramundians meet during work hours for pizza and chatting. Just because. #3 EXPERIENCE VALUE AND APPRECIATION We believe in values and live them: togetherness and trust. Courage, enthusiasm, and competence. Our communication culture is open and honest. Just like the regular team feedback sessions. #4 GET REWARDED You will also feel our appreciation. Success bonuses are as natural as Christmas bonuses, company pension plans, and team events. #5 ENJOY LIFE Work time is life time. That’s why you can organize it individually with us. With flexible working hours in full or part-time, home office, and even sabbatical options. #6 STAY HEALTHY We want you to feel good. That’s why we have ergonomic furniture and organize health days, massages, yoga, and running groups. #7 DEVELOP FURTHER Your personal and professional advancement is important to us. We pay for training and coaching during working hours. Even two-year work stays at our branch in the USA are possible. #8 WORK AT EYE LEVEL We are all on a first-name basis, from apprentices to management. We don’t have complicated hierarchies. #9 YOUR FAMILY IS IMPORTANT TO US Family means being there, caring, and supporting each other. We do this with daycare subsidies and holiday care, as well as at our family summer festival. #10 MAKE US EVEN BETTER We want to be a great place and employer. For that, we need honest feedback. title: Werkstudent Sales Development (m/w/d)
description: Wir suchen dich! Wir suchen einen Werkstudenten Sales Development (m/w/d), der uns dabei unterstützt, noch mehr Unternehmen für bessere Kundenkommunikation zu begeistern. Jeden Tag helfen wir Unternehmen dabei, ihre Kundenkommunikation einfacher, effizienter und besser zu gestalten. Damit noch mehr Unternehmen von unseren Lösungen profitieren können, möchten wir unseren Kundenstamm gezielt erweitern und neue Kontakte aufbauen. Du hast Freude daran, dich in Unternehmen einzulesen, die richtigen Ansprechpartner zu identifizieren und den ersten Kontakt herzustellen? Du bist neugierig, kommunizierst gerne und lässt dich von einem Nein nicht aus der Ruhe bringen? Dann passt du zu uns. Vorerfahrungen im Vertrieb sind dabei kein Muss. Viel wichtiger ist, dass du Interesse an Menschen, Unternehmen und guter Kommunikation mitbringst. Den Rest bringen wir dir bei. Wir arbeiten hybrid, mit klaren Zuständigkeiten und engem Austausch im Team. Nach deiner Einarbeitung kannst du überwiegend remote arbeiten. Für Trainings, Feedbackgespräche, Teamtage oder andere wichtige Termine freuen wir uns, wenn du nach Absprache an einem unserer Standorte dabei bist. Deine Aufgaben Du recherchierst Unternehmen, die zu unseren Zielkunden passen. Du identifizierst relevante Ansprechpartner und pflegst Informationen in unserem CRM. Du unterstützt bei der Ansprache potenzieller Kunden per E-Mail, Telefon und LinkedIn. Du führst erste Gespräche mit Interessenten und prüfst gemeinsam mit dem Team, ob ein passender Bedarf besteht. Du vereinbarst qualifizierte Termine für unser Vertriebsteam. Du dokumentierst Aktivitäten und Erkenntnisse sauber in unseren Systemen. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns Ansprachesequenzen weiter und testest, welche Ansätze gut funktionieren. Du gibst Rückmeldungen aus Gesprächen und Recherchen an Vertrieb und Marketing weiter. Deine Rolle bei uns Du bist kein Praktikant im Hintergrund, sondern Teil unseres Vertriebsteams. Du lernst, wie moderne Neukundengewinnung im B2B-Umfeld funktioniert, übernimmst schrittweise mehr Verantwortung und arbeitest eng mit unseren Vertriebskollegen zusammen. Wenn du langfristig im Vertrieb arbeiten möchtest, kannst du dich bei uns perspektivisch in Richtung Sales Development Representative oder Account Executive weiterentwickeln. Dein Profil Must-haves Du bist an einer Hochschule oder Universität eingeschrieben. Du kommunizierst gerne mit anderen Menschen. Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und eigenverantwortlich. Du bist neugierig und arbeitest dich gerne in neue Themen ein. Du hast keine Scheu davor, aktiv auf Menschen zuzugehen. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Nice-to-haves Erste Erfahrungen im Kundenkontakt, Service, Vertrieb, Recruiting oder einer vergleichbaren Tätigkeit. Interesse an Vertrieb, Software, Digitalisierung oder Kundenservice. Erste Berührungspunkte mit LinkedIn, CRM-Systemen oder anderen digitalen Tools. Interesse daran, langfristig Erfahrungen im B2B-Vertrieb zu sammeln. Warum wir? Die „Basics“: 30 Tage Urlaub, hybrides Arbeiten möglich, ein fester Feierabend, ein Budget für deine Weiterentwicklung, Team-Events, JobRad, Altersvorsorge und eine Spendit-Card sind einige der Angebote, die unsere comdesk´ler zu schätzen wissen Arbeit mit Sinn: Mit deiner Arbeit hast du einen positiven Einfluss auf Millionen von Menschen. Unsere Lösungen sind immer einen Herzschlag voraus und setzen neue Standards im Kundenservice. So leistest du mit deiner Arbeit einen echten Mehrwert und trägst dazu bei, dass Service Hotlines ihrem Namen endlich wieder alle Ehre machen Teamwork: Was wir an der comdesk besonders lieben? Unsere Kollegen (w/m/d)! Wir halten einander den Rücken frei, nehmen uns selbst nicht zu ernst und können uns immer aufeinander verlassen. Bei uns ist Team Work keine hohle Phrase! Gemeinsam wachsen: Dein Wissen ist unser aller Gewinn. Deshalb spielen wir dir regelmäßig Updates auf, in Form von Konferenzen, Workshops, Kursen, Trainings, neuester Technik – was immer du brauchst, um dich beruflich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln Kein Lari-Fari: Was du tust, vergammelt nicht in einer Schublade, sondern kommt zum Einsatz. Auf unnötige Bürokratie und stundenlange Meetings haben wir keine Lust. Wir arbeiten fokussiert, hands-on und mit einem Blick fürs Wesentliche Klingt spannend? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung als Werkstudent Sales Development (m/w/d) bei comdesk! Du hast noch Fragen? Melde dich gerne bei uns. Du arbeitest dich gerne in die Abläufe und Herausforderungen eines Unternehmens ein, bevor du über Produkte sprichst? Du führst Gespräche auf Augenhöhe, denkst in Lösungen und möchtest aktiv zum Wachstum eines Unternehmens beitragen? Dann suchen wir dich. Wir arbeiten hybrid, mit klaren Zuständigkeiten und engem Austausch im Team. Deine Aufgaben Du gewinnst neue Kunden und begleitest sie vom Erstgespräch bis zum Vertragsabschluss. title: Senior Application Security Engineer (all genders)
description: Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com. We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond. We are looking for our first dedicated Application Security Engineer to build our AppSec practice from the ground up. This is a greenfield opportunity with a real attack surface: public partner-facing APIs, payment flows, and active bug bounties. You will own secure development, define what gets reviewed, implement security gates, build the "paved road" for ~150 engineers, and see the impact of your work in production within weeks. What you will do: Lead threat modeling and secure design reviews for high-risk changes, partner integrations, and payment flows. Implement, tune, and enforce security gates in GitLab CI/CD (SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, and DAST) while minimizing developer friction. Act as the primary technical owner for triaging, reproducing, and prioritizing findings from bug bounties, partner pentests, and automated scanners. Work hands-on with the DevOps team to implement GCP organizational policies, IAM least-privilege architectures, and Cloud Armor (WAF/rate limiting). Establish a security-champions network across engineering squads and leverage automation/AI-assisted tooling to scale code reviews effectively. Workplace: We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe. Also, the HQ office is in Berlin, where the team often meets. Who you are: You bring 5+ years in AppSec (or 3+ years plus a strong software engineering/web-pentesting background), with a track record of true ownership. You read and write production code (Python, Go, TypeScript, Ruby, etc.) and deeply understand web frameworks, CI/CD, and Kubernetes. You have deep knowledge of web and API security, specifically authentication/authorization models (OAuth2, JWT), rate limiting, tenant isolation, IDOR, and XSS. You have strong cloud security fundamentals (GCP preferred), specifically regarding public exposure, secrets hygiene, and WAF rules. You prioritize by real-world risk, propose trade-offs rather than demanding perfection, and communicate complex risks plainly to engineers and leadership. Bonus Points: You have experience securing high-volume, multi-tenant B2B APIs and utilizing AI tooling to accelerate triage and review. What you can expect: You will join a fast-paced travel tech company with a flat organizational structure. You will have exciting opportunities, ownership, and responsibility and contribute directly to the success of the company. You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day! We have a flexible work policy with the option of working remotely and international opportunities arising as we continue to expand our global footprint – Our heart is in Berlin, but you’ll find us across the globe. You will get a competitive salary. Our hiring team for this role: Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Lorena Rebenciuc, and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Ilya Isakov. For any queries, contact your Talent Partner at Do you want to work on a product that is used by millions of people daily with a high load, availability and scalability, and most advanced technology?  Come join us! title: Werkstudent KI & Automatisierung (m/w/d)
description: Prozesse verstehen. Lösungen bauen, die bei KMUs tatsächlich laufen. Warum es diese Stelle gibt Wir sind ein kleines Team in Neumarkt und entwickeln IoT-Cloud-Lösungen für Maschinen- und Fahrzeughersteller. Parallel bauen wir eine Automatisierungsplattform, mit der wir Prozesse automatisieren – für uns selbst und für unsere Kunden. Mit KI-Agenten, LLM-Anbindungen und der Integration bestehender Fachsysteme. Der Bedarf ist größer als das, was wir nebenbei erledigen können. Deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der genau daran arbeitet: bestehende Prozesse aufnehmen, verstehen wo es klemmt, und dann eine Lösung bauen, die läuft. Was wir nicht suchen: jemanden, der Konzepte schreibt, die niemand umsetzt. Und keine Forschungsprojekte. Unsere Lösungen müssen zu einem Mittelständler passen – also einfach genug, dass sie auch ohne dich weiterlaufen. Aufgaben Was du machst Prozesse aufnehmen. Du sprichst mit den Menschen, die einen Prozess täglich durchlaufen – bei uns oder beim Kunden. Du hältst fest, wie er heute wirklich läuft (nicht, wie er laut Handbuch laufen sollte), wo Zeit verloren geht und was am Ende besser sein soll. Konzipieren. Du entscheidest, welcher Teil sich automatisieren lässt, wo KI echten Mehrwert bringt und wo eine einfache Regel genügt. Du schätzt Aufwand und Nutzen ab und legst dem Prozessowner eine Empfehlung vor – keine Optionsliste. Umsetzen, hands-on. Du baust die Lösung selbst: KI-Agenten auf Basis von LLM-APIs, Automatisierungs-Workflows, Anbindung bestehender Systeme über REST-Schnittstellen und Webhooks, dazu die nötige Datenaufbereitung. Und ein Skript in Python oder JavaScript, wo Klicken nicht reicht. Review und Übergabe. Du gehst mit dem Prozessowner durch, ob die Lösung im Alltag hält. Du prüfst nach, dokumentierst so, dass eine andere Person daran weiterarbeiten kann, und übergibst sauber. Qualifikation Was du mitbringen musst Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch. Du führst Prozessgespräche mit Anwendern und Prozessownern, teils bei Kunden im Mittelstand. Das geht nicht auf Englisch. Verhandlungssicher heißt: du diskutierst frei, auch wenn es fachlich und sprachlich kompliziert wird. Mindestens ein Tag pro Woche vor Ort in Neumarkt in der Oberpfalz. Prozessaufnahme funktioniert im Gespräch, nicht im Ticketsystem. Die übrige Zeit arbeitest du flexibel und remote. Echte Begeisterung für KI und erste eigene Erfahrung damit. Kein Zertifikat, kein Studienschwerpunkt – aber du musst schon einmal selbst etwas mit KI gebaut haben. Ein Agent, ein LLM-Workflow, ein Chatbot auf eigenen Daten, ein Automatisierungsskript mit angebundenem Modell. Wir fragen im Gespräch danach, und zwar im Detail. Dazu: laufendes Studium – Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Technologie- oder Innovationsmanagement oder etwas Vergleichbares. Die Fachrichtung ist uns weniger wichtig als deine Arbeitsweise. Du hast eine Sache schon einmal zu Ende gebaut – nicht nur angefangen. Du kannst dich in einen fremden Prozess hineindenken und die richtigen Fragen stellen. Du schreibst so, dass andere es verstehen. Was wir gerne sehen, aber nicht erwarten Praxis mit LangChain, LangGraph oder vergleichbaren Agenten-Frameworks Erfahrung mit RAG, Vektordatenbanken oder Prompt Engineering über Spielerei hinaus Grundlagen in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript und SQL Arbeit mit KI-Coding-Tools wie Claude Code, GitHub Copilot oder Cursor Ausdrücklich kein Muss: n8n. Wir arbeiten damit, aber diesen Teil deckt eine Kollegin bereits ab. Wenn du es kennst, gut – wenn nicht, lernst du es hier in wenigen Tagen. Benefits Was du bekommst Echte Verantwortung für eigene Prozesse – vom ersten Gespräch bis zum Livegang. Keine Zuarbeit. Anleitung durch unser Senior-Team, aber viel Freiraum in der Umsetzung. Arbeit mit aktuellen KI- und Automatisierungswerkzeugen an produktiven Systemen, nicht an Sandkastenprojekten. Kleines Team, kurze Wege, Entscheidungen am selben Tag. 15–20 Stunden pro Woche im Semester, in den Semesterferien nach Absprache mehr. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze zu einer KI- oder Automatisierungslösung, die du selbst gebaut hast : Wie lief der Prozess vorher, was hast du gebaut, welches Modell oder Tool hast du eingesetzt und warum, was war danach besser? title: Senior Application Security Engineer (all genders)
description: Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com. We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond. We are looking for our first dedicated Application Security Engineer to build our AppSec practice from the ground up. This is a greenfield opportunity with a real attack surface: public partner-facing APIs, payment flows, and active bug bounties. You will own secure development, define what gets reviewed, implement security gates, build the "paved road" for ~150 engineers, and see the impact of your work in production within weeks. What you will do: Lead threat modeling and secure design reviews for high-risk changes, partner integrations, and payment flows. Implement, tune, and enforce security gates in GitLab CI/CD (SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, and DAST) while minimizing developer friction. Act as the primary technical owner for triaging, reproducing, and prioritizing findings from bug bounties, partner pentests, and automated scanners. Work hands-on with the DevOps team to implement GCP organizational policies, IAM least-privilege architectures, and Cloud Armor (WAF/rate limiting). Establish a security-champions network across engineering squads and leverage automation/AI-assisted tooling to scale code reviews effectively. Workplace: We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe. Also, the HQ office is in Berlin, where the team often meets. Who you are: You bring 5+ years in AppSec (or 3+ years plus a strong software engineering/web-pentesting background), with a track record of true ownership. You read and write production code (Python, Go, TypeScript, Ruby, etc.) and deeply understand web frameworks, CI/CD, and Kubernetes. You have deep knowledge of web and API security, specifically authentication/authorization models (OAuth2, JWT), rate limiting, tenant isolation, IDOR, and XSS. You have strong cloud security fundamentals (GCP preferred), specifically regarding public exposure, secrets hygiene, and WAF rules. You prioritize by real-world risk, propose trade-offs rather than demanding perfection, and communicate complex risks plainly to engineers and leadership. Bonus Points: You have experience securing high-volume, multi-tenant B2B APIs and utilizing AI tooling to accelerate triage and review. What you can expect: You will join a fast-paced travel tech company with a flat organizational structure. You will have exciting opportunities, ownership, and responsibility and contribute directly to the success of the company. You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day! We have a flexible work policy with the option of working remotely and international opportunities arising as we continue to expand our global footprint – Our heart is in Berlin, but you’ll find us across the globe. You will get a competitive salary. Our hiring team for this role: Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Lorena Rebenciuc, and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Ilya Isakov. For any queries, contact your Talent Partner at Do you want to work on a product that is used by millions of people daily with a high load, availability and scalability, and most advanced technology? title: Videograf / Content Producer (m/w/d)
description: SKINBRO ist eine der am schnellsten wachsenden Männerpflege-Marken Deutschlands. Feste Duschseifen, Deos und Parfums – plastikfrei, made in Germany, mit Düften, die Männer wirklich wollen. Über 90.000 Kunden, in den letzten Monaten jeden Monat fast verdoppelt. Wir sitzen in Hamburg, sind ein kleines, schnelles Team und wachsen ohne Konzernstrukturen. Unser Wachstum kommt aus Creatives. Aktuell produzieren wir rund 300 Ads im Monat mit einem Shooting pro Woche. Mit dir wollen wir auf drei Shootings pro Woche und über 1.000 Assets im Monat. Spoiler: Wir suchen keinen klassischen Videografen und keinen Creative Director. Wir suchen die Person, die Ideen in die Realität bringt. Die Creative Strategie – Konzepte, Skripte, Angles, Briefings – kommt fertig vom Gründer. Du bekommst am Anfang der Woche deine Shooting-Pläne und ziehst sie von A bis Z durch. Um dich herum: externe Video-Editoren, ein Grafikdesigner, ein eingespielter Prozess. Das ist eine ausführende Rolle, keine konzeptionelle. Wenn du lieber selbst die Strategie machen willst, ist das nicht die richtige Stelle. Wenn du Bock hast, in einer Creative-Maschine zu arbeiten, die bereits funktioniert, und sie mit uns zu verdreifachen – dann schon. Aufgaben Du führst 2–3 Shootings pro Woche eigenständig durch – ohne dass der Gründer am Set stehen muss. Du organisierst alles drumherum: Location, Darsteller, UGC-Creator, Zeitplan, Equipment, Verpflegung. Du sourcst regelmäßig neue Gesichter für Straßeninterviews, Schauspieler-Spots und UGC. Du bedienst die Kamera selbst und lieferst sauberes, verwertbares Rohmaterial nach Briefing. Du legst das Material strukturiert ab und übergibst es mit klarem Briefing an unsere Editoren. Du gibst den Editoren fundiertes Feedback und schneidest bei Bedarf selbst. Du analysierst gemeinsam mit dem Gründer, welche Creatives performt haben und welche nicht – und nimmst die Learnings mit ins nächste Shooting. Qualifikation Du kannst Shootings komplett selbstständig durchführen – Planung, Dreh, Ablage. Du kannst editieren (Premiere, CapCut, DaVinci o. ä.) – gut genug, um Editoren präzise zu briefen, ihr Ergebnis zu bewerten und selbst Videos zu schneiden. Du hast Feingefühl am Set: Du empfängst Leute, machst sie locker, korrigierst taktvoll und sorgst dafür, dass alle gerne wiederkommen – auch bei Skripten, die etwas frecher sind. Du hast ein Gespür dafür, welche Person welche Aussage am glaubwürdigsten rüberbringt. Du arbeitest strukturiert nach Prozess und Checkliste und hast kein Problem damit, Content in hoher Frequenz zu produzieren, ohne dass die Qualität leidet. Du verstehst, was eine Performance-Ad von einem schönen Video unterscheidet – oder willst es schnell lernen. Du wohnst in Hamburg oder bist bereit, hierher zu ziehen. Benefits Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Gründer-Team. Ads, die jeden Monat Millionen von Männern sehen – du siehst sofort, was dein Output bewirkt. Als Projektmanager stellst du sicher, dass Kampagnen schnell, sauber und effizient umgesetzt werden – ohne Reibungsverluste.

Perfekt für dich, wenn du bereits Agenturerfahrung hast und weißt, wie wichtig Tempo, Struktur und saubere Prozesse sind.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

  • Operative Umsetzung: Eigenständige Durchführung und technische Umsetzung von Marketing-Aufgaben und Kampagnen im Tagesgeschäft.
  • Daily Management & Ticketing: Strukturierte Erfassung, Bearbeitung und Nachverfolgung aller eingehenden Aufgaben und Kundenanfragen.
  • Schnelle Kundenkommunikation: Sicherstellung extrem kurzer Reaktionszeiten. Kunden erhalten zeitnah (z. B. innerhalb von 30 bis 60 Minuten) eine erste Rückmeldung oder Zwischenantwort bei Anfragen.
  • Koordination: Steuerung der Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams (z. B. Grafik und Copy). Du erstellst Briefings, definierst klare Deadlines und nutzt Projektmanagement-Tools (z. B. ClickUp) für reibungslose Abläufe.
  • Qualitätssicherung: Einleitung, Koordination und konsequente Nachverfolgung von Korrekturschleifen bis zur finalen Freigabe.
  • Problemlösung: Schnelles und pragmatisches Lösen von technischen oder organisatorischen Hürden im laufenden Betrieb.

Du trägst die Verantwortung für eine zuverlässige operative Umsetzung und die konsequente Einhaltung aller Deadlines. Gleichzeitig stellst du sicher, dass alle Prozesse technisch sauber, fehlerfrei und mit hoher Reaktionsgeschwindigkeit in der Kundenbetreuung umgesetzt werden.

Qualifikation

Das solltest du sein:

➜ Du hast mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Projektmanagement und Marketing

➜ Du arbeitest strukturiert, extrem organisiert und proaktiv

➜ Du bist zuverlässig und kannst viele parallele Aufgaben (Tickets) effizient managen

➜ Du denkst lösungsorientiert und bringst technisches Verständnis mit

➜ Du kommunizierst klar, präzise und schnell – sowohl schriftlich als auch mündlich

Benefits

Was wir dir bieten:

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Jede Person, die wir einstellen soll langfristig mit uns wachsen. Das Ziel jeder Einstellung ist eine unbefristete Übernahme.
  • Tolle Arbeitsatmosphäre: Der Umgang untereinander ist sehr kollegial und familiär. Wir ziehen alle am gleichen Strang und motivieren uns gegenseitig Bestleistungen zu erzielen und persönlich zu wachsen. Es gibt zudem ein monatliches Team-Lunch auf Kosten der Firma.
  • Gute Vergütung & Karrierechancen: Unsere Mitarbeiter: innen erhalten eine faire Vergütung und vermögenswirksame Leistungen. Über die nächsten Jahre werden wir weiter wachsen und expandieren. Daher benötigen wir weitere Experten und/oder Führungskräfte

...und noch viel mehr:

  • Modernes Büro in zentraler Lage in Düsseldorf Pempelfort mit Dachterasse und Anschluss an ÖPNV
  • Stetige Weiterbildung & Karriere
  • Zusammenhalt in einem dynamischen und kollegialen Team
  • Ein attraktives Gehaltsmodell
  • Monatliches Teamessen, Firmen-Events, Messen, Vorträge und Veranstaltungen
  • Sehr gute Arbeitsmittel, beste Hardware von Apple, höhenverstellbare Tische

title: AI-First Data Engineer (m/f/d)
description: Join Sport Alliance and help build the data platform behind Magicline and Finion, serving thousands of gyms and 10M+ members. You'll tackle real engineering challenges, from high-volume data modeling and cost-efficient warehousing to freshness trade-offs and financial data that has to be exactly right. We're building an AI-first data team. We use cutting-edge LLMs and internal tools to work faster, and we expect you to use and improve them. The platform you build powers our AI and analytics, making clean, reliable, well-modeled data essential. Whether you're an experienced engineer ready to own the platform or a strong mid-level engineer eager to grow into the role, we'd love to hear from you. Your position in our team Build and optimize cloud-native data pipelines on AWS — ETL/ELT and the infrastructure underneath (Aurora, Redshift, dbt, Spark/EMR, Airflow, CDC) — using AI tooling as a standard part of the workflow. Design and evolve the data models that power analytics, operational use cases, and AI/ML across thousands of studios. Help raise the bar on data reliability — embed governance, testing, and lineage so both people and AI systems can trust the numbers by default. Partner with product, and other engineering teams to turn ambiguous business problems into robust data solutions. Evaluate and evolve new approaches with us — data mesh patterns, and emerging AI tooling — and help decide what genuinely earns a place in our stack. Grow into our financial and regulatory reporting workstream (Finion Capital), where correctness and auditability matter most. Your profile 3+ years in data engineering with a focus on data warehousing — and the appetite to take on more ownership than you've held so far. Strong SQL and Python for data work. Working with AI tools feels natural to you — and, just as important, the judgment to review and validate what they produce. You treat AI output as a draft to verify, not an answer to trust, especially where correctness is non-negotiable. A solid grasp of data architecture and modeling principles (dimensional modeling, slowly-changing dimensions, incremental patterns) — or the drive to deepen it fast. Hands-on experience with dbt on a cloud warehouse — this is where you'll live day to day. Working knowledge of relational and some exposure to non-relational Databases (DynamoDB, MongoDB). A track record of debugging tricky data issues and shipping durable fixes. Excellent written and verbal English. Nice to have AWS experience (Redshift, EMR, Glue, S3, IAM); experience with GCP or Azure is also welcome. Streaming/CDC technologies (Kafka, Kinesis, Debezium) or data mesh. Experience building data pipelines for ML or AI systems. Exposure to financial, payments, or regulated reporting data. German (helpful for some stakeholder work, but not required). Your salary We offer a salary range of EUR 72,000 – EUR 82,000 per year. Final compensation will be based on experience, skills, and overall fit for the role. Strong organizational and pipeline-management skills, with a systematic approach to tracking opportunities and following through on commitments. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and concisely. High integrity and customer orientation, with a commitment to honest communication rather than overselling. Strong sense of urgency and ability to operate at the pace of technically sophisticated, fast-moving customers. raw.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Executive based in Germany.

This is a highly technical sales role focused on helping engineering teams adopt infrastructure and developer-focused technology.
You will own opportunities from initial engagement through close, working directly with technically sophisticated customers who expect credibility and speed.
The role combines consultative selling, technical problem-solving, proof-of-concept management, and disciplined pipeline ownership.
You will work closely with Solutions Engineers while becoming a trusted presence in customer communication channels and helping remove obstacles to purchase.
Success requires the confidence to explain complex concepts simply, challenge assumptions, and be transparent when a solution is not the right fit.
You will operate with significant autonomy in a fast-moving environment where experimentation, urgency, and customer outcomes matter.
This is an opportunity for either an experienced technical AE or a technically minded professional ready to take ownership of a sales quota.


Accountabilities
  • Own the sales process from qualified opportunity through successful close, with a strong focus on helping technical customers achieve their desired outcomes.
  • Build trusted relationships with engineers and technical stakeholders, including actively participating in customer communication channels such as Slack.
  • Manage and close inbound sales opportunities, moving prospects efficiently through the buying process.
  • Lead and coordinate proof-of-concept initiatives in partnership with Solutions Engineers, ensuring technical and commercial objectives are clearly defined.
  • Help customers troubleshoot questions and remove technical or commercial obstacles that could prevent a successful purchase.
  • Communicate honestly and transparently, including clearly explaining when a solution is not an appropriate fit.
  • Maintain a systematic approach to pipeline management, ensuring opportunities, next steps, and follow-ups are consistently tracked.
  • Navigate, improve, and contribute to internal sales and go-to-market systems and processes.
  • Experiment with new approaches to prospect engagement, deal execution, and GTM workflows, using results and customer feedback to continuously improve.
  • Move quickly and independently, identifying what needs to be done and taking action without requiring detailed direction.

    • Requirements

    • Proven experience as an Account Executive, particularly in a technical B2B, SaaS, infrastructure, or developer-focused sales environment; alternatively, strong technical experience combined with readiness to take on a sales quota.
    • Strong technical aptitude, including the ability to comfortably understand API documentation, technical product concepts, and engineering workflows.
    • Experience selling to developers or engineering teams is highly desirable, with an understanding of how to build credibility with technically sophisticated buyers.
    • Strong organizational and pipeline-management skills, with a systematic approach to tracking opportunities and following through on commitments.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and concisely.
    • High integrity and customer orientation, with a commitment to honest communication rather than overselling.
    • Strong sense of urgency and ability to operate at the pace of technically sophisticated, fast-moving customers.
    • Self-directed and resourceful, with the ability to take ownership and make progress without extensive supervision.
    • Curious and experimental mindset, with a willingness to test new approaches, learn from unsuccessful experiments, and adapt quickly.
    • Experience with databases, search technologies, or infrastructure software is a plus.
    • Familiarity with GTM automation tools such as Clay or n8n is advantageous.
    • Comfort working with Python, JavaScript, Linux, or major cloud platforms is a plus.
    • Willingness to prioritize correctness, customer evidence, initiative, and continuous improvement in day-to-day decision-making.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote working environment.
      • Opportunity to work from Canada, the United States, or Europe.
      • Significant autonomy and ownership over your work.
      • Direct exposure to highly technical customers and engineering teams.
      • Opportunity to work closely with Solutions Engineers and technical stakeholders.
      • Chance to develop expertise across databases, search, infrastructure, and developer-focused technology.
      • Fast-moving environment that encourages experimentation and learning from results.
      • Opportunity to influence and improve internal go-to-market systems and processes.
      • Role with direct commercial impact and responsibility for closing meaningful technical deals.

title: Medical Director (m/w/x)
description: Role Als Medical Director verantwortest du den medizinischen Themenkatalog einer der größten CME-Lernplattformen Deutschlands. Was wir zeigen, erreicht unzählige Ärzt:innen – deine inhaltlichen Entscheidungen haben unmittelbaren Einfluss darauf, welches medizinische Wissen in Deutschland ankommt. Du führst unser siebenköpfiges Medical Team, hältst den Kontakt zu Chefärzt:innen und Meinungsbildner:innen, entwickelst neue Fortbildungsformate mit und baust die Prozesse, mit denen wir vom Startup zum Scale-up werden. Die Rolle ist bewusst breit: strategisch in der Katalog- und Formatentwicklung, operativ im Tagesgeschäft, und immer mit der ärztlichen Perspektive als Maßstab. Your tasks Verantwortung für den Themenkatalog: Du steuerst, welche medizinischen Themen wir abdecken – fachübergreifend, evidenzbasiert und mit einem klaren Blick für Versorgungsrelevanz und Lücken im Markt. Referenten-Netzwerk: Du bist tagtäglich im Austausch mit Chefärzt:innen und KOLs, baust langfristige Beziehungen auf und gewinnst daraus kontinuierlich neue Fortbildungsideen. Team-Leadership: Du führst und entwickelst unser Medical Team – zwei Vollzeitkolleg:innen und fünf Studierende. Die Medical Editors arbeiten inhaltlich und stimmen Projekte mit Sponsoren und Referent:innen ab; die Medical Students übernehmen Quality Control, erstellen Kursbeschreibungen und entwickeln neue Themenideen. Formatentwicklung: Wir produzieren Videos, Panel-Diskussionen und E-Learnings – Form und Inhalt greifen ineinander. Bei neuen Formaten wie Kurzvideos oder der Gamification des Lernerlebnisses ist dein medizinischer Input und die ärztliche Perspektive der entscheidende Faktor. Projekt- und Themensteuerung: Du managst die Themenideen laufender Projekte und stimmst dich eng mit Referent:innen ab, damit Projektanforderungen inhaltlich sauber umgesetzt werden. Qualitätssicherung & Compliance: Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Fortbildungen den CME-Standards entsprechen, evidenzbasiert sind und die regulatorischen Anforderungen erfüllen. Prozessverbesserung & Automatisierung: Auf unserem Weg zum Scale-up stehen Automatisierung und schlanke Prozesse im Mittelpunkt. Du streamlinest Workflows und Dokumentationstools im Team und teamübergreifend – als Director bist du dabei die Schlüsselrolle für funktionierende Cross-Department-Zusammenarbeit. Your profile Hintergrund: Abgeschlossenes Studium der Medizin. Berufserfahrung: Idealerweise 5+ Jahre Berufserfahrung, gern klinisch, in der Industrie oder in der digitalen Gesundheitsbranche. Führungserfahrung: Erste Erfahrung als Team Lead ist ein klarer Vorteil – entscheidend ist, dass du Menschen entwickeln und Prioritäten setzen kannst. Anpack-Mindset: Wir skalieren. Du regelst Dinge selbst, statt sie nur zu delegieren, und scheust dich nicht davor, auch operativ mit reinzugehen. Begeisterung für Prozesse: Du hast Freude an Projektmanagement, Strukturaufbau und medizinischem Content bzw. medizinischer Lehre – diese Kombination ist der Kern der Rolle. Von Vorteil: Erfahrung in einem Startup sowie in der medizinischen Lehre. Kommunikationsstärke: Sicheres Auftreten gegenüber führenden Mediziner:innen und Industriepartnern, professioneller Kommunikationsstil mündlich und schriftlich. Sprachen: Deutsch auf Muttersprachenniveau und fließendes Englisch sind Voraussetzung. Why us? Echter Impact: Die Themen, die du verantwortest, erreichen über zig tausende Ärzt:innen. Durch die Verbreitung des neuesten medizinischen Wissens hast du direkten Einfluss auf die Versorgungsqualität in Deutschland. Mitgestaltung: Du prägst neue Fortbildungsformate und den medizinischen Qualitätsanspruch der Plattform von Grund auf mit. Wachstum & Perspektive: Wir wachsen schnell – entsprechend gibt es echte Aufstiegs- und Gestaltungschancen, die mit dem Unternehmen mitwachsen. Ownership: Kurze Entscheidungswege, flache Hierarchien und die Freiheit, eigene Ideen umzusetzen. Team: Ein junges, motiviertes und wirklich gutes Team in Prenzlauer Berg. Teamevents, Ausflüge sowie Bier und Wein im Kühlschrank gehören dazu. Benefits: Attraktives Gehaltspaket inkl. Aktienpaket (VSOP) sowie ein Urban Sports Club Abo. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

company: SUXXEED Sales for your Success GmbH
description: #Gemeinsam : Wir machen B2B-Vertrieb aus Leidenschaft. Über 350 Mitarbeitende unterstützen Geschäftskund:innen bei dem Vertrieb ihrer Produkte und Lösungen. #Erfolgreich : Wir gestalten den Vertrieb der Zukunft und stoßen Innovationen an. Dabei arbeiten wir agil in starken, dynamischen Teams. #Zukunftsorientiert : Wir wachsen immer weiter. Deshalb suchen wir dich. Wir bieten dir einen sicheren, unbefristeten Arbeitsplatz mit Perspektive. Werde jetzt Teil der SUXXEED-Community! Aufgaben Das erwartet dich bei uns: Aufbau von KI Business-Cases begleiten: Du unterstützt unsere AI Business Case Analysts dabei, wirtschaftlich relevante KI-Anwendungsfälle zu identifizieren, zu analysieren und zu belastbaren Business Cases auszuarbeiten. Geschäftsprozesse analysieren und verbessern: Du analysierst Prozesse in Vertrieb, Customer Operations und internen Unternehmensbereichen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Teams Ideen zur Automatisierung und Optimierung KI-Potenziale bewerten und priorisieren: Du hilfst dabei, den wirtschaftlichen Nutzen von KI-Lösungen messbar zu machen und bei der Priorisierung neuer Projekte fundierte Entscheidungsvorlagen zu erstellen Management-Reports und KPIs entwickeln : Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Präsentationen, Business Cases, KPI-Modellen und Management-Unterlagen für laufende und geplante KI-Initiativen. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit AI Engineers und Fachbereichen: Als Teil eines neu aufgebauten AI Center of Excellence arbeitest du direkt mit Fachbereichen, AI Engineers und Führungskräften zusammen und erhältst einen umfassenden Einblick in die Entwicklung und Umsetzung moderner KI-Lösungen. Qualifikation Mit diesem Profil überzeugst du: Du befindest dich aktuell in einem Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Business Analytics, Digital Business oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs mit Schwerpunkt AI. Du begeisterst dich für die wirtschaftlichen Einsatzmöglichkeiten von KI und möchtest lernen, wie daraus belastbare Business Cases entstehen. Optimalerweise hast du bereits an der Erstellung von Business Cases mitgewirkt. Du denkst unternehmerisch und hast Freude daran, Zusammenhänge zu analysieren, Daten auszuwerten und Lösungen strukturiert aufzubereiten. Zudem verfügst du idealerweise über erste Kenntnisse in Datenanalyse, Business Intelligence, Controlling, Prozessmanagement oder KPI-Steuerung. Du möchtest praktische Erfahrungen in einem innovativen Umfeld sammeln und kannst regelmäßig an unserem Standort in Nürnberg arbeiten Strukturierte Arbeitsweise und ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit auf Deutsch (mind. C1-Niveau): Komplexe Zusammenhänge kannst du verständlich darstellen Benefits Das bieten wir dir: Du wirst Teil eines zukunftsweisenden Bereichs mit hoher strategischer Bedeutung für unser Unternehmen, arbeitest an realen KI-Projekten mit messbarem Business Impact und übernimmst früh eigene Verantwortung. Für deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung: ein professionelles Onboarding & persönliches Mentoring durch erfahrene Kolleg:innen aus den Bereichen AI, IT und Business Development Langfristige Perspektive mit der Möglichkeit, nach deinem erfolgreich abgeschlossenen Studium in eine Festanstellung übernommen zu werden Eine faire Vergütung von 1.000€ pro Monat bei einer fest planbaren Anwesenheit von 2 Tagen pro Woche. Bei einem privaten Studium, beispielsweise an der FOM oder IU, können wir dir zusätzlich einen Zuschuss zu den Studiengebühren von bis zu 400 Euro monatlich gewähren Zusätzliche Rabatte über die Vodafone-Mitarbeitertarife und Benefit-Partnerportale sowie jährliche steuerfreie Bezuschussung auf deine Benefit Card bis zu 150€ Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! description: Für einen etablierten mittelständischen Anlagenbauer aus der Umwelt- und Verfahrenstechnik suchen wir aktuell eine:n Business Development Manager (all genders). Das Unternehmen entwickelt und realisiert anspruchsvolle Anlagen zur Wasser- und Abwasserbehandlung und begleitet seine Kunden über die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette vom Konzept bis zur Inbetriebnahme. Der Fokus dieser Position liegt auf dem Auf- und Ausbau eines gesetzlich getriebenen, europaweit wachsenden Marktsegments. Aufgaben Sie treiben den Auf- und Ausbau eines wachsenden europäischen Marktsegments für die 4. Reinigungsstufe zur Spurenstoffelimination (EU und Schweiz) voran und verantworten dabei den gesamten Weg von der Priorisierung relevanter Länder und Märkte bis zum Vertragsabschluss. Sie sprechen Anlagenbetreiber, Kommunen sowie Planungs- und Ingenieurbüros gezielt an und begleiten diese entlang der Phasen öffentlicher Vergabeverfahren im Bereich der Wasseraufbereitung. Sie kalkulieren und erstellen technische Angebote, führen Verhandlungen und begleiten Ausschreibungsprozesse. Sie beraten Betreiber und Planungsbüros zu passgenauen Anlagenlösungen und arbeiten dabei partnerschaftlich zusammen. Sie bilden die Schnittstelle zwischen Vertrieb und Projektabwicklung und bringen Impulse zur technischen und organisatorischen Weiterentwicklung des Produktbereichs ein. Sie entwickeln länderspezifische Markterschließungsstrategien vor dem Hintergrund der aktuellen regulatorischen Entwicklungen. Sie repräsentieren das Unternehmen auf Fachmessen und Branchenveranstaltungen. Sie bringen bereits Erfahrung aus dem Umfeld der Trink- bzw. Abwasserbehandlung mit, etwa aus einem Ingenieur- oder Planungsbüro, aus dem Anlagenbau oder aus der Zulieferindustrie. Sie kennen sich idealerweise mit öffentlichen Vergabeverfahren aus und haben idealerweise Erfahrung mit der VOB und den Leistungsphasen der HOAI. Sie verbinden vertriebliches Geschick mit echtem technischem Interesse und bringen Fachwissen aktiv in Beratung und Marktentwicklung ein. Sie kommunizieren verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und gut auf Englisch für die Arbeit im europäischen Umfeld. Sie überzeugen durch Kommunikationsstärke, Teamorientierung, unternehmerisches Denken und Eigeninitiative und möchten sich langfristig in einem kleinen, kulturbewussten Team verwurzeln. Sie bringen Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Europas mit (etwa 25%). Benefits 60.000 - 80.000 EUR p.a. Wir begleiten Fach- und Führungskräfte auf ihrem nächsten Karriereschritt, im DACH-Raum und international, entlang der gesamten Bandbreite dieser Branchen: von Membranfiltration, Prozessfiltration und Wasseraufbereitung über mechanische, chemische und thermische Verfahrenstechnik bis hin zu verfahrenstechnischen Komponenten wie Pumpen, Armaturen, Ventilen und Wärmetauschern. Unser Netzwerk umfasst mehr als 40.000 Fach- und Führungskräfte aus Chemie, Pharma, Maschinenbau und Umwelttechnik. Als reine Branchenspezialisten kennen wir die Unternehmen, Technologien und Entscheidungswege im Detail und beraten Sie persönlich, vertraulich und mit echtem technischem Verständnis. title: Principal Engineer, Mobile Platform & Backend Systems
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About AlphaSense:&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content. </span></p> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&amp;P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!</span></p></div><h3><strong>About the Team</strong></h3> <p>Our diverse Product &amp; Engineering team values innovation, collaboration, and the continuous improvement of our platform. We offer a dynamic work environment where employees can grow and thrive while working on cutting-edge technology that shapes the future of AI and search.</p> <p>At AlphaSense, we believe that diverse experiences and perspectives are critical to our success. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and empowered to be their authentic selves.</p> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>AlphaSense is moving beyond search with <a href="https://www.alpha-sense.com/press/alphasense-introduces-superanalyst-the-always-on-ai-execution-layer-for-decision-grade-intelligence/">SuperAnalyst</a>: AI-powered workflows that monitor change, update outputs, and surface what matters as situations evolve. Mobile brings that intelligence into the moments when customers are away from their desks.</p> <p>Delivering those experiences through native applications presents a distinctive engineering challenge: services evolve continuously while released apps remain in customers' hands. Designing for that reality creates an opportunity to shape how AlphaSense builds shared product capabilities, with benefits reaching well beyond iOS and Android.</p> <p>Based in Mobile Engineering, you will use a close connection to customer and product needs to shape backend systems across engineering organizations. You will help decide which cross-team problems to tackle and where architectural investment will have the greatest impact, then work with the owning engineers to build and prove the solution in production.</p> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Shape the systems behind product experiences:</strong> Set technical direction for client-facing APIs and the backend architecture behind them. Work with service and platform owners to simplify how backend services connect and support product workflows across clients.</li> <li><strong>Lead across engineering organizations:</strong> Work across application, search and AI, and shared platform teams to shape technical priorities around customer and product needs. Represent Mobile with senior engineering leaders, Product, and customers, building agreement on the architecture and investment needed to deliver shared capabilities.</li> <li><strong>Turn architecture into production systems:</strong> Lead delivery of services and subsystems that span team boundaries, from choosing the technical approach to implementing the hardest parts and proving them in production. Design these systems for reuse beyond the initial use case.</li> <li><strong>Shape shared identity and access:</strong> Partner with User Management and platform teams to evolve how users authenticate, maintain sessions, and access product capabilities across Web and Mobile. Build native-client requirements into shared identity and configuration services.</li> <li><strong>Leave engineers and teams stronger:</strong> Help engineers deepen their technical judgment and build the expertise to own and evolve the systems you deliver together. Combine hands-on delivery with coaching and reusable patterns, whether embedding with an existing team or bringing engineers together around a focused mission with leadership support.</li> </ul> <h3>What We're Looking For</h3> <p>Your strongest experience should be in backend and platform engineering, with client needs informing your architectural decisions. Prior iOS or Android development experience is not required.</p> <h3>Required:</h3> <ul> <li>Deep production backend and distributed-systems expertise, including service boundaries, data ownership, consistency, failure recovery, and integration models. A track record of simplifying complex architectures with impact across teams or domains.</li> <li>Strong hands-on engineering experience, with significant personal contributions to production code and system evolution. Ability to develop a deep understanding of unfamiliar codebases and turn investigation into sound engineering decisions.</li> <li>Experience designing client-facing REST and GraphQL APIs, with sound judgment about business-logic placement, product states, and backward compatibility. Understanding of how mobile lifecycle and network constraints affect backend design.</li> <li>Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, entitlements, and session management, including trust boundaries and the security implications of client-service interactions.</li> <li>Experience improving customer-visible reliability and performance across client and backend systems, with practical expertise in observability and production validation.</li> <li>A track record of leading consequential technical change across teams through influence rather than reporting authority.</li> <li>Product and stakeholder leadership that connects technical decisions to customer value. Demonstrated success challenging assumptions and building alignment with senior leaders, balancing immediate customer and product needs with durable foundations other teams can build on.</li> </ul> <h3>Preferred:</h3> <ul> <li>Experience building production systems for AI-powered search, research, or analysis workflows.</li> <li>Experience with enterprise identity and managed applications, such as Auth0, Microsoft identity, or MDM/MAM ecosystems.</li> <li>Experience designing shared configuration or service discovery for multi-tenant platforms and dedicated customer environments.</li> <li>Experience designing and building event-driven systems, including publish/subscribe or event-streaming architectures such as Kafka.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. description: <p><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p>Explore how a next-generation AI architecture behaves from rack scale to data centre scale.&nbsp;</p> <p>As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will investigate a novel AI computing architecture under demanding real-world workloads. You will also help develop tooling and automation to collect, analyse and visualise system metrics.</p> <p>You do not need to be an AI expert. In 2026, VML was named<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span><em>Campaign’s</em> Global Network of the Year and ranked #2 Creative Network of the Year at Cannes Lions. description: About us At Sierra, we’re building a platform to enable every company in the world to build better, more human customer experiences with AI. We partner with industry leaders such as SoftBank, Uber, Rivian, CLEAR, and Sutter Health. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia. We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and Family. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do. Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor . Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace. What you'll do As an Agent Strategist , you own how Sierra's AI agents come to life for our customers — from first pilot to a production agent handling thousands of conversations a day. You sit at the intersection of product, building agents and customer-facing work, and stay just as close to the technology as you are to the people you build for. You transform a customer's thorniest, highest-stakes problems into agents that measurably move their business. Own the Agent Development Life Cycle . Take agents from initial scope through conversation design, tooling, and evaluation, to launch and continuous iteration in production — translating business goals into an agent that outperforms, and tuning relentlessly until it's the best version of itself in the real world. You'll have real ownership and autonomy over the outcome. Be the trusted strategic advisor to enterprise leaders. Sit shoulder-to-shoulder with our customers' executives, understand what success actually means to their business, and shape the AI strategy that gets them there. Partner with the customer's working teams day to day. Run working sessions, troubleshoot the agent as issues come up, and make the calls that keep the build on track for launch. Directly impact product. Surface unmet needs from your customer work, and feed them back to research and platform to shape where Sierra goes next. Example projects These are the kinds of projects that strategists on our team have worked on recently: Scope and launch a subscription-retention agent for a large telecommunications or media company that consistently outperforms human agents at saving at-risk customers. Stand up an agent for a commerce customer that troubleshoots a broken device end-to-end and personalizes product recommendations in the same conversation. Redesign the conversation flows for a financial services agent so it can handle complex, regulated interactions — and convert a pilot into a multi-team production deployment. See our financial services blog for examples. Partner with product on a net-new capability — a new agent architecture or self-service tooling — using a live customer as the design partner. Define the evaluation and quality bar for a new agent, then use those metrics to drive a measurable lift in outcome week over week. What you'll bring Customer obsession. Genuine energy being in front of customers — understanding their business and needs, thriving in complex organizations, and building trusted relationships. Communication. Clear, direct, and persuasive across technical and non-technical audiences. Strategic problem-solving in ambiguity. Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills to break down complex problems, spot risks early, and adapt as things change fast. Technical aptitude. Comfortable engaging directly with technical concepts - reading API documentation, understanding data models and system architecture, and following engineering tradeoffs in a design discussion. Ownership and delivery. A track record of running multiple complex, high-visibility projects at once and driving them to outcomes. Even better... Experience building or deploying AI/LLM agents in production — hands-on with the tools behind them (eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG, prompt engineering) — working closely with technical counterparts. You've been a founder, founding team member, or operator — you know how to balance craft, ownership, and speed. A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience — and/or an MBA or comparable experience at the intersection of technology and business. Our values Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work. Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it. Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve. Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time. Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements. What we offer We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees: Flexible (unlimited) paid time off Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family Life insurance and disability benefits Retirement plan dependent on country of employment Parental leave Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most Free alphorn lessons These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies. Be you, with us We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. raw.title: Senior Account Manager
raw.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

 

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our EMEA Account Management team led by Stanislas Joly, VP Account Management Global. The team consists of 5 Account Managers, each managing a portfolio of enterprise clients across different EMEA markets. Together, you'll be driving growth and retention for Mirakl's most strategic clients across the region, while regularly exchanging best practices and deal learnings with your counterparts in the AMER account management team.
"As a Senior Account Manager, you will be part of an international team of fun colleagues based in London, Boston, Bordeaux, and Paris. We connect through weekly syncs to share best practices and team wins, regular meet-ups for team-building activities, quarterly business reviews to align everyone on objectives, and a global yearly Sales Kick-off." — Stanislas Joly, VP Account Management Global
 

2. Your Impact

  • Own and grow a portfolio of enterprise platform accounts, identifying and executing upselling and cross-selling opportunities across Marketplace, Drop Ship, and Catalog Manager products, managing complex sales cycles end-to-end with support from regional and specialist teams
  • Build trusted, long-term relationships with C-level executives and key decision-makers at strategic accounts, serving as their go-to partner for marketplace strategy and growth
  • Develop and execute account plans that align client business objectives with Mirakl's roadmap, unlocking expansion opportunities across multiple markets and business units
  • Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Marketing teams to deliver a seamless, high-value experience throughout the client lifecycle
  • Stay ahead of industry trends and the competitive landscape to proactively address client challenges and position Mirakl as the definitive platform of choice
 

3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:
  • 8+ years in account management, sales roles managing global or strategic accounts in a SaaS or technology environment
  • Proven track record of driving revenue growth through upsell and cross-sell motions with complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise clients
  • Experience working in an international context, with the ability to navigate cultural nuances across EMEA markets
Skills:
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to design and execute long-term account plans that create mutual value
  • Strong business acumen to understand complex client business models and connect them to Mirakl's solutions
  • Outstanding communication skills for engaging and influencing senior stakeholders across multi-stakeholder, international environments
  • Financial and analytical rigour to interpret complex contracts and assess revenue implications with confidence
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the drive to proactively build pipeline and unlock new growth opportunities
 

4. Tools Used

  • Salesforce
  • Mirakl internal tools
 

5. Languages

  • English: Fluent — C2 level required
  • French: Fluent — C2 level required

6. Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.
Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application, this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.
  1. Intro call with Talent Acquisition — 30 minutes to explore your background, motivations, and answer any questions about Mirakl
  2. Interview with Stanislas (VP Account Management Global) — Deep dive into your account management approach, commercial track record, and motivation
  3. Values-based interviews — Conversations with colleagues from across the business to assess alignment with Mirakl's core values
  4. Sales pitch exercise — A strategic presentation to demonstrate your commercial thinking and approach to enterprise account management

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

    • Identify emerging markets, funding streams and policy-driven opportunities that align with Plexal's strategic objectives.

    • Shape and co-own Plexal's cross-government go-to-market strategy. 
    • Identify priority growth areas, departments and opportunity themes aligned to Plexal's strengths. 
    • Support the development and refinement of propositions that respond to changing government needs. 
    • Build repeatable approaches to opportunity identification, qualification and pursuit. 
    • Strengthen commercial discipline and opportunity management across the organisation. 
    • Support the creation of scalable propositions that can be applied across multiple government customers and sectors.
  • Strategic Relationship Management & Ecosystem Development
    • Act as a senior external representative for Plexal across government, industry and innovation ecosystem engagements. 
    • Build trusted relationships with senior government leaders, policy makers, commercial stakeholders and delivery partners. 
    • Establish Plexal as a credible voice within conversations around innovation, technology adoption, economic growth and government transformation.

    • Build and shape consortium opportunities where partner-led approaches strengthen Plexal's position.

    • Number and quality of strategic opportunities shaped prior to procurement.

    • Conversion rate improvement across priority pursuits. 
    • Growth in partner-led opportunities and consortium wins. 
    • Strength and depth of senior relationships across government and strategic partners.

  • Commercially driven, outcome-focused and highly proactive.

As a Production Support Engineer II at Marqeta, you will play a pivotal role in our commitment to customer satisfaction and the seamless operation of our products and services. 

You will serve as the first line of contact for our customers, adeptly handling and resolving complex technical issues while translating technical jargon into user-friendly language. Your broad knowledge base across various technologies will be instrumental in addressing a wide range of problems. In addition, you will collaborate with our Engineering teams to manage software updates and bug fixes. 

Your role will also involve becoming an expert in all areas of Marqeta's products and services and ensuring that our customers can fully utilise our offerings. As a customer advocate, you will ensure that our customers' needs and concerns are heard and addressed in our product development and service delivery processes. We work Flexible First. This role can be performed remotely within the UK or from our London office. We’d love for you to join us!

The Impact You’ll Have

  Who You Are

  • Ability to work in a customer-facing role, with strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to listen, show empathy, and also be able to converse with both internal and external technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Committed, flexible through on-call rotations, and demonstrated ability to maintain high levels of productivity with minimal supervision
