description: Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call. Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a  Senior Full-Stack Engineer  to build the platform that catches data problems before they become business problems. About Us Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing. Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). Founded in 2006, we are a global business with a presence in 12 offices across four continents, serving over 200 luxury clients with a team of 250 professionals.  

At CXG, we are passionate about evolving, elevating, and transforming experiences to bring brand promises to life. We offer strategic solutions that impact performance and elevate the customer and employee experience for some of the world's most iconic premium and luxury brands.

What you will be doing 

Your primary mandate will be to open and develop high-value opportunities within specific priority verticals, named accounts, and strategic growth initiatives defined by the Chief Customer Officer. You will bring a strong hunter mindset and an established network within the luxury and premium ecosystem, while working closely with the existing Customer Development team to strengthen our pipeline, respond to strategic opportunities, and position CXG as a long-term partner.  

Your daily tasks will involve: 

  • Translating the strategic growth priorities defined by the Chief Customer Officer into focused business development plans for selected verticals, markets, and target accounts. 
  • Leveraging your established network and market credibility to secure access to senior decision-makers and create new opportunities with high-potential luxury and premium brands. 
  • Building and maintaining a qualified new-business pipeline, with a strong focus on originating new relationships, opening doors, and converting priority prospects into clients. 
  • Supporting the wider Customer Development team on strategic pursuits, including account research, opportunity qualification, pitch preparation, and coordinated responses to requests for proposal and competitive tenders. 
  • Leading the full commercial cycle for assigned opportunities, from prospecting and qualification through proposal development, tender response, negotiation, and closing. 
  • Designing compelling, insight-driven and commercially sound proposals that articulate CXG's differentiated value, with appropriate pricing, margin, scope, and contractual alignment. 
  • Promoting a cross-practice approach and actively supporting the go-to-market of CXG’s new solutions by connecting client needs to our expertise across Measurement, Academy, Customer Insights, and Consulting, and translating them into integrated, multi-practice commercial opportunities. 
  • Working closely with market Customer Success, regional leaders, Operations, and Practice Leads to build integrated solutions that are relevant, feasible, and impactful. 
  • Ensuring structured handovers to Customer Success and remaining involved during the early stages of the client relationship to protect commercial commitments, revenue, and client trust. 
  • Representing CXG in relevant industry events and senior client environments, while sharing market intelligence, relationships, and best practices with the Customer Development team. 

Requirements

What you will bring along 

This role is designed for an experienced business developer who combines a strong hunter mentality, an active senior-level network, and the ability to collaborate effectively on complex opportunities. You should also bring: 

  • A Master's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field. 
  • At least 8 years of experience in business development, strategic sales, account development, or consulting, ideally within an international environment. 
  • Deep knowledge of the luxury, retail, or premium services ecosystem, supported by an established and demonstrable network of senior decision-makers. 
  • A proven track record of originating opportunities, winning new logos, and closing high-value, multi-stakeholder deals. 
  • Strong experience preparing and leading complex proposals, requests for proposal, and competitive tender responses in a consultative or multi-solution environment. 
  • The credibility and influencing skills required to engage C-level, regional, and operational stakeholders. 
  • Strong negotiation and commercial judgment, including the ability to manage pricing, margin, scope, and contractual discussions. 
  • Excellent presentation, storytelling, and written communication skills. 
  • A high level of ownership, autonomy, resilience, and accountability, combined with a collaborative mindset and the ability to contribute to shared team priorities. 
  • Fluency in French and English, both written and spoken. Additional languages are a strong advantage.

raw.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

 

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our EMEA Account Management team led by Stanislas Joly, VP Account Management Global. The team consists of 5 Account Managers, each managing a portfolio of enterprise clients across different EMEA markets. Together, you'll be driving growth and retention for Mirakl's most strategic clients across the region, while regularly exchanging best practices and deal learnings with your counterparts in the AMER account management team.
"As a Senior Account Manager, you will be part of an international team of fun colleagues based in London, Boston, Bordeaux, and Paris. We connect through weekly syncs to share best practices and team wins, regular meet-ups for team-building activities, quarterly business reviews to align everyone on objectives, and a global yearly Sales Kick-off." — Stanislas Joly, VP Account Management Global
 

2. Your Impact

  • Own and grow a portfolio of enterprise platform accounts, identifying and executing upselling and cross-selling opportunities across Marketplace, Drop Ship, and Catalog Manager products, managing complex sales cycles end-to-end with support from regional and specialist teams
  • Build trusted, long-term relationships with C-level executives and key decision-makers at strategic accounts, serving as their go-to partner for marketplace strategy and growth
  • Develop and execute account plans that align client business objectives with Mirakl's roadmap, unlocking expansion opportunities across multiple markets and business units
  • Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Marketing teams to deliver a seamless, high-value experience throughout the client lifecycle
  • Stay ahead of industry trends and the competitive landscape to proactively address client challenges and position Mirakl as the definitive platform of choice
 

3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:
  • 8+ years in account management, sales roles managing global or strategic accounts in a SaaS or technology environment
  • Proven track record of driving revenue growth through upsell and cross-sell motions with complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise clients
  • Experience working in an international context, with the ability to navigate cultural nuances across EMEA markets
Skills:
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to design and execute long-term account plans that create mutual value
  • Strong business acumen to understand complex client business models and connect them to Mirakl's solutions
  • Outstanding communication skills for engaging and influencing senior stakeholders across multi-stakeholder, international environments
  • Financial and analytical rigour to interpret complex contracts and assess revenue implications with confidence
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the drive to proactively build pipeline and unlock new growth opportunities
 

4. Tools Used

  • Salesforce
  • Mirakl internal tools
 

5. Languages

  • English: Fluent — C2 level required
  • French: Fluent — C2 level required

6. Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.
Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application, this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.
  1. Intro call with Talent Acquisition — 30 minutes to explore your background, motivations, and answer any questions about Mirakl
  2. Interview with Stanislas (VP Account Management Global) — Deep dive into your account management approach, commercial track record, and motivation
  3. Values-based interviews — Conversations with colleagues from across the business to assess alignment with Mirakl's core values
  4. Sales pitch exercise — A strategic presentation to demonstrate your commercial thinking and approach to enterprise account management

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

title: Account Executive
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Executive based in France. This is a highly technical sales role focused on helping engineering teams adopt infrastructure and developer-focused technology. You will own opportunities from initial engagement through close, working directly with technically sophisticated customers who expect credibility and speed. The role combines consultative selling, technical problem-solving, proof-of-concept management, and disciplined pipeline ownership. You will work closely with Solutions Engineers while becoming a trusted presence in customer communication channels and helping remove obstacles to purchase. Success requires the confidence to explain complex concepts simply, challenge assumptions, and be transparent when a solution is not the right fit. You will operate with significant autonomy in a fast-moving environment where experimentation, urgency, and customer outcomes matter. This is an opportunity for either an experienced technical AE or a technically minded professional ready to take ownership of a sales quota. Accountabilities Own the sales process from qualified opportunity through successful close, with a strong focus on helping technical customers achieve their desired outcomes. Build trusted relationships with engineers and technical stakeholders, including actively participating in customer communication channels such as Slack. Manage and close inbound sales opportunities, moving prospects efficiently through the buying process. Lead and coordinate proof-of-concept initiatives in partnership with Solutions Engineers, ensuring technical and commercial objectives are clearly defined. Help customers troubleshoot questions and remove technical or commercial obstacles that could prevent a successful purchase. Communicate honestly and transparently, including clearly explaining when a solution is not an appropriate fit. Maintain a systematic approach to pipeline management, ensuring opportunities, next steps, and follow-ups are consistently tracked. Navigate, improve, and contribute to internal sales and go-to-market systems and processes. Experiment with new approaches to prospect engagement, deal execution, and GTM workflows, using results and customer feedback to continuously improve. Move quickly and independently, identifying what needs to be done and taking action without requiring detailed direction. Requirements Proven experience as an Account Executive, particularly in a technical B2B, SaaS, infrastructure, or developer-focused sales environment; alternatively, strong technical experience combined with readiness to take on a sales quota. Strong technical aptitude, including the ability to comfortably understand API documentation, technical product concepts, and engineering workflows. Experience selling to developers or engineering teams is highly desirable, with an understanding of how to build credibility with technically sophisticated buyers. Strong organizational and pipeline-management skills, with a systematic approach to tracking opportunities and following through on commitments. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and concisely. High integrity and customer orientation, with a commitment to honest communication rather than overselling. Strong sense of urgency and ability to operate at the pace of technically sophisticated, fast-moving customers. Self-directed and resourceful, with the ability to take ownership and make progress without extensive supervision. Curious and experimental mindset, with a willingness to test new approaches, learn from unsuccessful experiments, and adapt quickly. Experience with databases, search technologies, or infrastructure software is a plus. Familiarity with GTM automation tools such as Clay or n8n is advantageous. Comfort working with Python, JavaScript, Linux, or major cloud platforms is a plus. Willingness to prioritize correctness, customer evidence, initiative, and continuous improvement in day-to-day decision-making. Benefits Fully remote working environment. Opportunity to work from  Canada, the United States, or Europe . Significant autonomy and ownership over your work. Direct exposure to highly technical customers and engineering teams. Opportunity to work closely with Solutions Engineers and technical stakeholders. Chance to develop expertise across databases, search, infrastructure, and developer-focused technology. Fast-moving environment that encourages experimentation and learning from results. Opportunity to influence and improve internal go-to-market systems and processes. Role with direct commercial impact and responsibility for closing meaningful technical deals. title: Deployment Lead - ERP Solutions
description: What We Do Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight. Rillet is the AI-native ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG. This huge market is ours to take. We’ve raised $200M+ from Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI. Who We Are Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility. The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for. Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan. Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software. Who We Need We are building industry-defining accounting and finance software. We are looking for an experienced Deployment Lead to guide complex customer implementations and help finance teams successfully transition onto Rillet. This role is ideal for someone who has led ERP implementations and understands how to turn complex accounting and operational requirements into practical systems solutions. You may come from an ERP implementation firm, Big 4 finance transformation practice, systems consulting team, or a SaaS company serving finance organizations. You are comfortable owning multiple workstreams, advising senior stakeholders, and navigating the details of configuration, data migration, integrations, testing, and go-live. You will combine strong implementation judgment with a customer-first mindset—bringing structure to ambiguity, identifying risks early, and keeping customers and internal teams moving toward a successful launch. We’re primarily looking for teammates who are based near our New York City or San Francisco offices, or open to relocating. For this role, we’re also open to remote candidates based anywhere in the United States. Our hybrid schedule brings office-based team members together in person on Tuesdays and Thursdays, plus one additional flexible day each week. Some roles may spend more time in the office depending on the needs of the team. What You'll Do Lead key parts of customer onboarding and deployment, helping ensure a smooth and timely implementation experience Partner with internal teams across Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to execute implementation plans and solve customer problems quickly Learn and analyze client accounting and finance workflows, then translate those needs into clear requirements and practical solutions Guide customers through onboarding, training, change management, and adoption Support data migration, reconciliations, systems setup, and integration coordination Track milestones, drive follow-through, and keep internal and external stakeholders aligned throughout the onboarding process Identify risks early, escalate issues quickly, and help keep customer launches on track Build trust with customers by being responsive, thoughtful, and solutions-oriented Maintain clear documentation and provide regular status updates to customers and internal stakeholders Who We're Looking For 4–7 years in ERP implementation, systems consulting, or finance transformation (e.g., Big 4 or implementation firms) Background in SaaS, high-growth technology companies, or implementation/consulting environments is strongly preferred Hands-on ERP experience (NetSuite, SAP, Workday, etc.), including requirements, configuration, data migration, and go-live Strong understanding of core accounting workflows (close, reconciliations, ASC 606) and how they translate into systems Customer-facing with strong communication and stakeholder management skills Systems-minded with solid project management skills; able to run multiple workstreams Comfortable in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and highly detail-oriented Experience working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams The expected base salary range for this role varies by location: Tier A: $100,000 – $150,000 Tier B: $100,000 – $140,000 Tier C: $100,000 – $130,000 Your compensation tier is based on your primary work location. You can view Rillet’s compensation zones here. Final compensation within the applicable range will depend on factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and the scope of the role. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits. Note: All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @ rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam. Life at Rillet Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales. Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create. Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals. Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings. At Payflows, we build software that helps large companies manage and automate their payment workflows. It’s not the flashiest part of a business, but it’s one of the most critical: invoices, approvals, payments, and controls. When these things slow down, the whole company feels it.

But our ambition goes further than just building a better workflow tool.

We believe the future of finance operations is not faster clicking: it’s no clicking at all 🫳 🎤

Finance teams shouldn’t spend their days moving data from one screen to another. Software should do the operational work, and humans should focus on reviewing, approving, and making the decisions that matter.

That’s the direction we’re building toward: an agent-driven finance platform, where intelligent agents handle the repetitive tasks, and users stay in control.

We started in 2022 with a small team and a rough first version of the product. Three years later, we’re working with major companies across France, the UK, and the US while choosing to keep our team small and human-sized.

We moved fast, shipped a lot, and not everything was built in a perfect way. But it helped us learn quickly, sign real customers, and prove that the problem we’re solving truly matters.

In 2024, investors trusted us with a $25M Series A. That gives us the chance to keep growing while also strengthening our foundations and building the system that will power this agent-driven future.

Today, we’re about 35 people from many different countries, and we’re looking for a few amazing humans to join the next chapter. 🤗

🚀 What you’ll actually do

You’ll help build a product that real finance teams rely on every day.

For us, engineering is not just about clean code, it’s about reliability, clarity, and trust, especially when money and automation are involved.

In a typical week, you might:

  • Design and implement new services for a product feature.

  • Refactor an early service to make it more robust.

  • Investigate a performance or production issue.

  • Work with product and frontend to shape a new feature.

  • Review code and help teammates improve.

  • Build backend tools that our AI agents use to perform real finance operations.

  • Design safe, deterministic workflows where agents propose actions and humans review them.

Your time will be split between building new features and improving what already exists. Both matter.

You won’t just build endpoints. You’ll help shape the execution layer that our agents rely on: the APIs, data models, and workflows that let them act safely in production.

You’ll work closely with product, frontend, and customer-facing teams. We expect engineers to take ownership of parts of the system and help make them more reliable over time.

💻 Our current tech reality

Our stack evolves based on our challenges, but we care more about good design than trendy tools 🙏

Python is our core language. It helps us move fast, keep the code readable, and fits naturally with our AI-driven approach. A growing part of the system is built around agents that use our backend as a set of reliable, deterministic tools.

  • Core language: Python

  • Backend: FastAPI + Pydantic

  • Data: PostgreSQL

  • Infra: AWS, serverless when it makes sense

  • Performance: some Rust for critical paths

  • Architecture: multi-service backend, simple enough to reason about

Some parts of the system are clean and well-tested. Others were built quickly and need love. That’s the phase we’re in.

Over the next year, we’ll focus on:

  • Turning core workflows into reliable tools for our agents

  • Simplifying services

  • Improving tests and observability

  • Making performance more predictable

  • Cleaning up early code

We know we’re not perfect, but we care a lot about improving step by step.


✨ Who’s going to thrive with us

You’ll probably feel comfortable here if:

  • You like building products people actually use.

  • You are autonomous and take ownership of what you ship.

  • You take initiative and lead by example.

  • You’re curious and enjoy figuring things out.

  • You’re pragmatic about trade-offs.

  • You communicate with kindness and clarity.

This role is a great fit if you’re excited by the idea of:

  • Building systems that are used by AI agents, not just humans.

  • Designing reliable, safe automation in production.

  • Working on a product that is still early and evolving quickly.

You don’t need to know everything about AI. But you should be curious about it and excited to work in a system where agents are part of the core product 🤖

🧩 What you’ll get from this role

  • Real ownership over parts of the system.

  • Direct impact on customers and product decisions.

  • A small, human team where your work is visible and meaningful 🤝

  • A mix of feature work, system design, and technical improvements.

  • Exposure to real scaling and production challenges.

raw.description:
🌍 Our Vision & Mission

At Payflows, we give finance teams the tools to reclaim their time and energy. Our platform weaves together banking connectivity, payments, AI, and procurement so they can ditch the busywork and focus on what really moves the needle.

🤝 Why Join Us?

We’re a small, mighty team who’ve earned our stripes at Airbnb, Luko, BNP Paribas, and Facebook. It’s not always easy—things move fast, and we expect a lot—but if you’re hungry for impact, you’ll find it here.

🛠️ We’re builders at heart. We move fast, think deeply, ship often — and we’re always hungry to learn more. You'll collaborate closely with product and tech to craft elegant backend systems that scale as fast as we do.

🚀 What You’ll Do

You'll own the infrastructure for a product that real finance teams rely on every day.

For us, infrastructure is not just about uptime; it's about reliability, security, and trust - especially when money and automation are involved. The platform has to be boring in the best possible way: predictable, observable, and safe to deploy to.

  • In a typical week, you might:

    • Evolve our infrastructure-as-code to add a service, a queue, or a whole new environment.

    • Improve our CI/CD pipelines so engineers ship safely and fast, dozens of times a day.

    • Investigate a production issue: a latency spike, a failing deploy, a database under load.

    • Strengthen observability with dashboards, alerts, and traces, so we catch problems before customers do.

    • Harden our security, secrets management, and access controls.

    • Tune cost and performance across our AWS footprint.

Your time will be split between building new platform capabilities and making what already exists more reliable. Both matter.

You'll help shape the foundation that everything else stands on: the pipelines, environments, and guardrails that let engineers and our AI agents act safely in production.

You'll work closely with backend, frontend, and the AI team. We expect you to take ownership of the platform and make it more reliable over time, not wait for tickets.

💻 Our current tech reality

Our stack evolves based on our challenges, but we care more about good design than trendy tools

We're an AWS shop, and we lean on managed services and infrastructure-as-code so the system is reproducible and easy to reason with. A growing part of our world is making the backend a set of reliable, deterministic tools that AI agents can call, which raises the bar on reliability even further.

  • Cloud: AWS

  • Infra-as-code: Pulumi (Python)

  • Compute: ECS + Lambda, serverless when it makes sense

  • Data: PostgreSQL on RDS/Aurora

  • CI/CD: GitLab CI

  • Orchestration: Airflow (MWAA)

  • Observability: Grafana Cloud, CloudWatch, Sentry

  • Auth & identity: Cognito, IAM

  • Edge & frontend: API Gateway, ALB, AWS Amplify for the web app

Some of this is clean, version-controlled, and reproducible. Other parts grew fast and live a little too much in people’s heads instead of in code. Closing that gap is a big part of why this role exists.

Over the next year, we'll focus on:

  • Making every environment reproducible from code

  • Better observability and alerting, fewer surprises

  • Tightening the security and compliance posture that comes with handling enterprise finance data

  • Faster, safer deploys

  • Keeping AWS costs sane as we scale


🧑‍💻 What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience with Python or any other OOP language

  • Backend expertise: APIs, microservices, architecture best practices

  • Databases & SQL: Data modeling, query optimization

  • Git lover: Comfortable with version control and code reviews

  • Pragmatic engineering mindset: Build, test, refine, simplify—smart shortcuts when time is tight

🧩 Bonus points if you’ve worked on:

  • B2B SaaS or finance/ERP tools

  • BaaS APIs or payment infra

  • Serverless, AWS, event-driven architecture exposure

✨ Who's going to thrive with us

You'll probably feel comfortable here if:

  • You think in systems and instinctively automate yourself out of repetitive work.

  • You treat infrastructure as code, not as pets.

  • You stay calm during incidents and are genuinely good at root-causing.

  • You care about security, because you're handling other people's money.

  • You are autonomous and take ownership of what you ship.

  • You take initiative and lead by example.

  • You're pragmatic about trade-offs.

  • You communicate with kindness and clarity.

You don't need to know everything about AI - but you must be curious about it and excited to build the reliable foundation that agents run on 🤖

🧩 What you'll get from this role

  • Real ownership over the platform the whole company runs on.

  • Direct impact on reliability, security, and how fast every engineer can ship.

  • A mix of platform building, system design, and reliability work.

  • Exposure to real scaling and production challenges.

  • The chance to help build the foundation of an agent-driven product from the inside.

title: Développeur fullstack confirmé H/F (C#, .Net, Angular)
description: À propos de N2JSoft N2JSoft est une Fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la gestion des dépenses professionnelles. Fondée en 2015, elle compte aujourd’hui 20 000 clients et 1M utilisateurs dans 98 pays , faisant de N2F l’un des leaders du marché français. N2F simplifie la gestion des frais professionnels : photo des justificatifs, reconnaissance automatique, validation, export comptable, archivage à valeur probante , etc. L’objectif : faire gagner du temps aux entreprises tout en sécurisant leurs processus internes. Après une croissance progressive, l’équipe est passée de 20 personnes en 2021 à 220 aujourd’hui , portée par le succès produit et l’expansion internationale. Nous partageons un objectif commun : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des notes de frais et des factures fournisseurs. En 2021, N2JSoft a élargi son expertise avec Keeple , un logiciel RH dédié aux congés, absences et temps de travail (hors périmètre de ce poste). Nous prévoyons de recruter 100 nouveaux collaborateurs d’ici 2027 . Notre objectif est également d’accélérer la croissance de nos produits, ce qui passe par le renforcement de notre équipe de développement. Quelques chiffres 220 collaborateurs , dont 45 dans l'équipe tech Notre site est basé à Montagnat (01) avec un format de télétravail hybride ou full remote. L’équipe tech Notre équipe est composée de développeurs/euses full stack expérimenté(e)s , réparti(e)s en squads : Notes de frais, Cartes de paiement pro, Invoices, Core… Chaque squad réunit : développeurs/euses, tech lead, team lead, product manager et testeur/euses QA. Stack et pratiques Front : Angular 16/21 Back : .NET 10 – C# Infra : AWS BDD : MSSQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB Architecture : monolithe modulaire Bonnes pratiques : tests unitaires, revues de code, pair programming, couverture Qodana, Microsoft Release Flow. Méthodo : Agile Scrum, sprints de 2 semaines (daily, weekly, rétro, planning). Le profil recherché Rattaché(e) à un(e) Team Lead dans l'une des squads produit, tu disposes : D'une formation en informatique Bac+3 minimum De 3 ans d’expérience en .NET / C# (web ou backend) De 2 ans d'expérience sur Angular et de bonnes connaissances front-end (HTML/CSS, TypeScript) D'une bonne maîtrise de SQL D'une expérience avec les technologies Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) et Docker Et tu fais preuve : D' esprit d’équipe pour travailler dans un climat de confiance, d'entraide et de responsabilité partagée De curiosité et d'ouverture pour comprendre le besoin de nos utilisateurs et l'environnement technique De pragmatisme et rigueur pour produire un code fiable avec un impact maîtrisé. Les points d’attention : Il est crucial de bien comprendre le périmètre fonctionnel du produit pour réussir dans ce poste. Nous recherchons quelqu’un qui souhaite s’investir dans la durée et contribuer à la construction d’un projet pérenne, plutôt qu’à une mission ponctuelle. Les plus : Une croissance forte et continue (50% par an depuis 3 ans) dans une entreprise rentable Une structure claire et spécialisée avec une équipe tech solide et des squads bien identifiées Une stack moderne régulièrement mise à jour, avec des migrations planifiées et suivies Pas de micro management et une culture de travail basée sur la confiance et l’écoute La possibilité de faire du full-remote avec une semaine de présence par trimestre Processus de recrutement Préqualification avec nos recruteurs Test technique à réaliser en autonomie (7 jours de deadline) Entretien technique / code review avec notre équipe tech (1h) Entretien avec le CTO (40 min) A la fin du processus de recrutement, une rencontre plus informelle de 20 minutes peut être organisée afin de rencontrer tes futurs collègues. Télétravail : Environ 100 de nos collaborateurs travaillent en full remote , depuis différentes régions. Pour celles et ceux qui résident à proximité de nos locaux, une présence quotidienne est privilégiée (avec un jour de télétravail par semaine ). Les personnes situées à environ une heure de route viennent généralement deux jours par semaine sur site. Pour les collaborateurs en full remote , nous organisons une semaine de présence par trimestre , prise en charge par l’entreprise, afin de renforcer les liens avec l’équipe et de partager les temps forts de la vie interne. Ces semaines s’inscrivent dans notre rythme d’ événements trimestriels (ateliers, moments conviviaux, séminaires, etc.), qui participent à la cohésion et à la culture d’équipe. En résumé, nous adaptons le rythme de télétravail à la situation géographique de chacun , dans un esprit de flexibilité, de confiance et de collaboration . Rémunération et avantages 40–50k€ brut annuel en fonction de l’expérience/niveau technique CDI cadre – 37h/semaine Prime de vacances Chèques cadeaux, culture, rentrée scolaire Cours de musique sur site Événements d’équipe toute l’année N2JSOFT s'engage en faveur de la diversité, l'égalité hommes-femmes et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés. description: Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure. Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants. Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements. Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens. Envie d’imaginer la suite de cette histoire à nos côtés ? Ecrivez-nous ! Nous recherchons les talents d'un(e) Assistant(e) Talent Acquisition Specialist (H/F) pour rejoindre notre équipe à l’occasion d’un stage de 6 mois à partir de Janvier 2027. Ce poste est basé à Paris (75). Rattaché(e) au pôle Talent & Ressources Humaines, vous participerez à repérer et recruter les meilleurs talents de demain dans un contexte de croissance internationale.  Vous serez notamment en charge des missions suivantes : Accompagner l'équipe Talent sur différents recrutements de A à Z : - Nous fonctionnons à la manière d'un cabinet de chasse interne pour les différents métiers du siège et nous procédons régulièrement par approche directe - nous vous formerons à notre métier ; - Après avoir discuté du besoin avec le manager de pôle ou notre fondatrice et l'équipe Talent, vous démarrez en autonomie la phase d'identification de profils sur LinkedIn, de premiers contacts et de qualification téléphonique ; - En parallèle, vous postez une annonce et vous serez responsable du tri des CV ; - Vous assisterez, si vous le souhaitez, aux entretiens physiques avec un membre de l'équipe et vous suivrez le processus jusqu'au recrutement ;  Manager la campagne de recrutement des stages / alternances pour Juillet 2027 : vous recueillez le besoin auprès des managers, mettez en ligne les annonces, répondez aux interrogations des managers. Vous serez le/la référent(e) Talent sur ce sujet ; Détection de talents : vous assurez le traitement des candidatures spontanées et conduisez des échanges exploratoires avec les profils les plus prometteurs. Autres projets : en fonction de l'actualité de l'équipe, vous pourrez participer ponctuellement à des projets transverses du département ressources humaines (marque employeur, relations écoles, etc.).  Ce stage vous permettra d’avoir une bonne compréhension des différents métiers que nous avons chez Sézane et des enjeux d’une entreprise en fort développement tournée vers l’humain :) Requirements Vous êtes étudiant(e) et recherchez un stage de césure ou de fin d’études, vous possédez idéalement une première expérience en recrutement ou une grande curiosité ; Vous êtes organisé(e), rigoureux(se) et très bon(ne) communicant(e) ; Vous avez un attrait particulier pour le secteur de la mode ; Vous souhaitez travailler dans un environnement international, et pratiquez pour cela un Anglais courant. Sézane recrute et valorise tous les talents, quels que soient votre genre, âge, nationalité, culture, croyances religieuses et orientations sexuelles. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Chief of Staff for Engineering

About Us

Parity is one of the world's most experienced companies building the core infrastructure behind blockchain - the system that allows information and value to be shared securely without needing an intermediary. We're laying the foundation for a better web which respects the freedom and data of individuals, and empowers developers to build better, more trustworthy online services.

Our remote-first, global team develop open-source software that anyone can use or improve. This includes Polkadot, Polkadot SDK, and Kusama — key parts of the Web3 tech stack, the next generation of the internet.Our mission is to make Polkadot the most active and innovative community in blockchain, powering a new era of connected and decentralised applications.

About the Team

This role sits at the heart of Parity's leadership, working directly with our Founder to drive organisational alignment and execution across the company.

About the Role

You will work directly with Gavin Wood, Parity's Founder. Your job is to take his vision, goals and ideas, and turn them into clear decisions, aligned teams, and forward momentum. You will think 12 to 24 months ahead, not just manage what is on fire today. You understand that the decisions made now impact the future, and you treat them accordingly.

You will be a key partner to Directors across the business, our CEO, and the primary bridge between Gavin's priorities and the Acceleration team's execution.

What You'll Do

  • Operate as Founder's technical right hand. You will manage his context, his priorities, and his follow-through. You are available when it matters. You anticipate what he needs before he asks for it.

  • Turn chaos into clarity. Parity moves fast. You will work in an environment of competing half-thoughts, ambiguous mandates, and shifting priorities. Your job is to impose structure without killing momentum, and to spot the counterproductive plays before they cause damage.

  • Think long. You will not just solve today's problem. You will map the second- and third-order consequences of decisions being made now and make sure the right people are thinking about them.

  • Lead cross-functional problem solving. When something falls between departments, you pick it up. You have the technical credibility to engage with engineering leadership and the operational instinct to get things moving.

  • Own the leadership rhythm. OKRs, technical reviews, decision-making cadences, you design and run the operating system for Gavin's leadership team.

  • Manage up, across, and down. You will work with C-Level and Directors across different Functions of the business. Each is different. You will adapt your communication style to each of them without losing your own voice.

Your Skills

  • Technically credible. You have a background in engineering or engineering management. You can hold your own with a CTO, challenge timelines credibly, and evaluate the viability of new technical initiatives. You do not need to be a Blockchain Engineer, but you understand the ecosystem well enough to distinguish substance from hype.

  • A sophisticated operator. You have run complex, cross-functional programmes at a senior level, ideally having led a team or founded a company. You know how to create clarity from ambiguity, manage without authority, and drive decisions in organisations that do not move in straight lines. Experience managing leaders, including more junior managers, is a strong signal.

  • Exceptional communicator. Not just clear, adaptive. You can shift registers between a demanding Founder, Functions Leads, and a junior team member. You know what each person needs to hear and how they need to hear it.

  • A long-term thinker. You are not a damage limitation operator. You think about what the decisions being made today mean in 12 to 24 months. You bring that perspective into rooms where others are only looking at this quarter.

  • Believes in Web3. You do not need deep protocol experience. But you need to understand why this technology matters and be genuinely curious about where it is going. Candidates who are indifferent to the mission do not last here.

  • Thrives in ambiguity. Parity is not a machine. It is a high-conviction, fast-moving organisation with a demanding founder. You find that energising, not exhausting.

  • Academically strong. A high-calibre degree matters. If you have one, lead with it. If you don't, your track record needs to be exceptional.

About Working With Us

Joining Parity means joining teammates who are genuinely excited about the impact their projects are having, and the opportunity to grow alongside some of the brightest minds in the Web3 space! You’ll work remotely and flexibly, while still getting to meet your teammates throughout the year at team and company-wide retreats.

Upon receiving an offer, all candidates undergo a background check through Zinc, our trusted third-party provider. Team members will be taken on as a contractor via our UK entity. View our Applicant Notice to see how we use your data.

Parity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome diversity in our global team and care about everyone in our collective feeling included and welcome
